entities.summary: Friedrich Wilhelm Braun, also commonly known simply as Fritz, was a Brazilian basketball player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1964 Summer Olympics. Braun died in Rio Claro, São Paulo on 2 February 2025, at the age of 83.
